title: TRINITY ESALC-I GVPT2 and IR with frozen SMITH analytic metric
summary: Construct Wilson B and B prime automatically from the frozen SMITH definition; reject numerical B-prime fallbacks, derive G prime analytically and complete G double-prime by single-mode differences.
gates: Frozen SMITH definition and ESALC-I chart have the same full-rank Wilson row space
Sparse B prime has no numerical fallback primitives at any stencil point
Fixed SMITH-to-ESALC-I row transform and Cartesian angstrom-to-bohr derivative conversion
Complete vibrational G double-prime from single-mode differences of analytic Wilson G prime
Only reference and plus/minus single-mode Cartesian Hessians and dipole samples
Fermi-only resonance polyads and second-order IR transition moments
coordinate_policy: Use one frozen full-rank ESALC-I chart and a matching SMITH definition. Map native SMITH B rows to the chart with a fixed reference transformation; construct B prime at each single-mode point and reject any numerical fallback.
backend_policy: KeyMaker authorizes Cartesian E/G/H and dipole providers; SMITH supplies the frozen Wilson definition and B, the resident sparse B-prime builder supplies analytic derivatives, and TRINITY constructs G prime, G double-prime, GVPT2 and IR intensities.
